Also, I like how competitive the game gets with friends and family. Lastly, I like how you receive power-ups depending how many steps you got in the race, allowing you to either boost or knock players a few steps back; it gives off Mario Carts vibe, which makes walking more fun than it use to be.

reviews.title: Great App for Motivation & Connection
reviews.text:
I really enjoy this app! One of my favorite things about it is how motivating it is to see other people moving. If I notice someone ahead of me, it actually makes me want to get up and move my body so I can keep up or catch up. 😂 It turns movement into something fun and motivating instead of feeling like a chore.

I also really appreciate that although the app offers paid features, you can still use it and interact with your friends and family without having to spend money. It’s a great way to stay connected and encourage each other to be active.

The one thing I wish the app had is more interaction between users. For example, if I see someone doing an amazing job or notice that they’re in first place, I’d love to be able to send them a quick “Good job!” or give them a little encouragement. Even something simple like a “praise,” “poke,” or motivational reaction would make it more fun and interactive.

Overall, though, I really enjoy this app and I’m thankful for it. It motivates me to move, keeps me accountable, and gives me a fun way to connect with the people I care about. Definitely a great app! ❤️

reviews.title: Timezones
reviews.text:
This is an amazing app, honestly has made me, my friends, and my family more active. However there is one issue that I see. Timezones. There isn’t an accurate way to calculate scores properly when competing with others in different time zones. For example, the step counter ends at 9pm. Well which 9pm? For myself personally, I compete with my family and friends out East and West. So while EDT/EST finishes at 9pm first due to their time zone, MDT/MST are still able to continue because 9pm EDT/EST is 7pm MDT/MST. Yet when it comes to calculating final scores, it calculates based off of EDT/EST and therefore not calculating all Timezones, because for the group I’m in, those in MDT/MST have two hours to basically changes their scores however that’s not what actually occurs…as the scores calculate at 9pm EDT/EST but those in MDT/MST aren’t alerted as the app tells out countdown that we still have until 9pm MDT/MST.

A friend had a suggestion of being able to create separate groups. So it’s as if you’re tracking your steps across each group, but able to play boosters or actions cards on those in each group. And example would be group 1 and group 2 track your steps but your upgrade earned in group 1 can only be played in group 1. However you can earn an upgrade/action item in each group.
